t: This is the home of The Anne Frank Trust UK, a charity based in London that has existed since 1991. It was founded by Bertha Klug, who lived from 1920 to 2012. Klug matters here because she started the organisation, so everything the Trust does in the UK traces back to her. The material I have is thin, so I won't guess at the details of its programmes or work. What I can say is that this is a charitable organisation with a clear founder and a name that carries real weight.
